meta.title: 不对称才美：国画构图的不平衡美学
meta.title_en: Asymmetry Is Beautiful: The Unbalanced Aesthetics of Chinese Painting

scenes.title_en: The Viewfinder: Keep the Mass Off the Centerline
scenes.context: 马老师用取景框示范：荷叶形成的绿色块面不能落在画框上下的中线上。块面是画面里最重的视觉元素，居中就形成呆板的一半一半。
sentences: 拿这个取景框去框的时候，你尽量不要让荷叶形成的这个绿的块面，落在你这个框的上下的中线上。
When you frame with this viewfinder, try not to let the green mass of lotus leaves sit on the centerline of your frame.
the centerline（中线）
你尽量不要让荷叶形成的这个绿的块面，在你这个框的上下的中线上。
Try not to let the green block formed by the lotus leaves land on the vertical centerline of your frame.
a mass / a block（块面）
paraphrase: Let the heaviest shape hit the midline.
Keep the big green block out of the middle line.
scenes.speak: When you frame with this viewfinder, try not to let the green mass of lotus leaves sit on the centerline of your frame.

scenes.title_cn: 一半一半不好看，偏一侧才成立
scenes.title_en: Half-and-Half Is Ugly — Lean to One Side
scenes.context: 块面正好落在中线就是一半一半，是最不好看的构图。修正方向：要么天留多一点，要么荷叶留多一点——核心原则就是不要对称。
sentences: 那它就刚好一半一半，这样是不好看的。
Then it's exactly half-and-half, and that just doesn't look good.
half-and-half（一半一半）
你要么天留得多一点，要么荷叶留得多一点，就是不要对称。
Leave more sky on one side, or more lotus leaves on the other — just don't be symmetrical.
symmetrical（对称的）
paraphrase: An even split drains the frame.
scenes.speak: Then it's exactly half-and-half, and that just doesn't look good. Leave more sky on one side, or more lotus leaves on the other — just don't be symmetrical.

scenes.title_cn: 主体不居中，放黄金分割点
scenes.title_en: Don't Center the Subject — Use the Golden-Ratio Point
scenes.context: 即使花姿态很好看，也不能放在中间——中间太直白了。画近景时，要表达的主体要放在黄金分割点上，兼具聚焦与留白。
sentences: 这个花就不能放在中间，中间就太直白了。
The flower must not go in the center — the middle is too blunt.
too blunt（太直白）
你要表达的这个主体的东西，要在黄金分割点上。
The subject you want to express should sit on the golden-ratio point.
the golden-ratio point（黄金分割点）
paraphrase: 「主体放黄金分割点」换种说法
Anchor the subject at the golden ratio.
scenes.speak: The flower must not go in the center — the middle is too blunt. The subject you want to express should sit on the golden-ratio point.

scenes.title_cn: 统一之势 + 反叶破势
scenes.title_en: One Unified Momentum, Broken by a Counter-Leaf
scenes.context: 花头朝右、叶子朝右、枝也朝右，整个势统一向右走。但旁边一片朝左的反叶四两拨千斤，把势又掰回来——张力由此而生。
sentences: 花头朝右、叶子也朝右、枝也朝右，它这个势就都会往这边走。
The flower head, the leaves and the branch all face right, so all the momentum flows this way.
momentum（势/动势）
旁边有一个反叶是朝左的，就会有一个四两拨千斤的、把它又掰回去的这个感觉。
A counter-leaf beside it turns left, giving that feeling of a light touch swinging it back.
a counter-leaf（反叶）
paraphrase: Everything leans one way, energy gathers there.
A tiny opposite leaf re-routes the whole flow.
scenes.speak: The flower head, the leaves and the branch all face right, so all the momentum flows this way. A counter-leaf beside it turns left, giving that feeling of a light touch swinging it back.

scenes.title_en: Applied to Photos: Stand Off-Center, at the 3:7 Point
scenes.context: 把构图法则迁移到日常拍照：人在河塘前千万不要放正中间，要靠左或靠右，放在三七出枝的位置——和中国画写生一脉相承。
sentences: 千万不要把人放到正中间，人要在靠左或者靠右、三七出枝的地方。
Never place the person dead center — stand to the left or right, at the three-to-seven branching point.
the 3:7 branching point（三七出枝位）
paraphrase: Keep the person off the middle.
The subject emerges at roughly one-third.
scenes.speak: Never place the person dead center — stand to the left or right, at the three-to-seven branching point.

scenes.context: 中国画最讲究在不平衡当中去求一个平衡，最忌讳四平八稳。这是全片要义，也是可以迁移到任何视觉创作的底层心法。
sentences: 中国画里面最讲究的是在不平衡当中去求一个平衡，它最忌讳的是四平八稳。
Chinese painting values most seeking balance within imbalance — its greatest taboo is a stiff, even stability.
taboo（忌讳）
paraphrase: True harmony comes from an off-balance arrangement.
Perfectly even and still is the enemy.
scenes.speak: Chinese painting values most seeking balance within imbalance — its greatest taboo is a stiff, even stability.

practice.q: 「不要让块面落在中线上」怎么说？
practice.a: Don't let the mass sit on the centerline.

practice.q: 「一半一半不好看，宁可偏一边」怎么表达？
practice.a: Half-and-half looks dull — lean to one side instead.
Place the subject at the golden-ratio point.

practice.q: 「一片反叶把势掰回来」怎么讲？
practice.a: A counter-leaf swings the momentum back.

pitfalls: Put the flower dead center to make it the star.
Place it at the golden-ratio point.
Centering reads as blunt and artless — the golden point still makes it the star.
Keep everything perfectly symmetrical for a balanced look.
Break the symmetry and lean to one side.
Even split (half-and-half) is exactly what ink painting avoids; balance comes from imbalance.
Point every element in one direction to strengthen the momentum.
Add a small element in the opposite direction to swing it back.
A one-way flow leaks out of the frame; a tiny counter-leaf holds it with a 'light touch'.
shifts: 构图追求居中对称、四平八稳
避中线、放黄金分割点、用反叶破势——不平衡中求平衡
difficult_words: Don't let the mass sit on the centerline.
The green mass of lotus leaves.
All the momentum flows this way.
A light touch swings it back.
Its greatest taboo is even stability.
footer_notes: 原视频为国画写生构图教学（作者：跟着马老师学国画），英文为场景意译，适合跟读练习艺术审美类表达；ASR 专有名词已按语境校正（中国话→中国画、四两钵千斤→四两拨千斤、三七出支→三七出枝）。
